abstract: Does the gender composition of high school peers affect whether students pursue a science, technology, engineering, and mathematics (STEM) major at university? Using administrative data from British Columbia, Canada, I exploit idiosyncratic within-school variation in gender composition. I find that having larger proportions of female peers has large and strong effects on students' STEM major choice. Such effects differ in both sign and magnitude across gender, high school type, and stage of high school education.
abstract_zh: 高中同伴的性别构成是否影响学生选择大学科学、技术、工程和数学（STEM）专业？利用加拿大不列颠哥伦比亚省的行政数据，我利用校内性别构成的特殊变异。我发现，女性同伴比例较高对学生选择STEM专业有显著且强烈的影响。这种影响在性别、高中类型及高中教育阶段上，其方向和幅度均有所不同。
title: The effect of high school gender composition on university major choice: Evidence from Canada
title_zh: 高中性别构成对大学专业选择的影响：来自加拿大的证据

abstract: This study investigates how the interaction of political accountability and local officials' career incentives shapes the market for Municipal Corporate Bonds (MCBs) in China, taking the 2017 local government debt personal responsibility rule as a quasi-natural experiment. We develop a stylized incomplete-information bargaining model to analyze how the rule reshapes the bargaining equilibrium by rendering officials' observable characteristics credible signals of bailout incentives. Using a dataset of prefecture-level MCBs from 2008 to 2020, we empirically test the model's predictions and focus on separating officials' incentive effects from their inherent ability. Our core findings show that post-announcement of the rule, each additional year of a local party secretary's remaining time to retirement, a proxy for bailout incentives, reduces MCB spreads by approximately 2.5 basis points and increases issuance volume by about 2.0%. These effects are significantly amplified in fiscally stressed cities. Notably, under the 2017 rule, cities led by party secretaries with stronger bailout incentives can expand MCB issuance, which is contrary to the rule's original intent to rein in local borrowing.
abstract_zh: 本研究以2017年地方政府债务终身问责制为准自然实验，探究政治问责与地方官员职业激励的交互作用如何塑造中国市政企业债券市场。我们构建了一个简约的不完全信息讨价还价模型，分析该制度如何通过使官员可观测特征成为纾困激励的可信信号，重塑讨价还价均衡。基于2008-2020年地级市市政企业债券数据集，我们实证检验模型预测，并重点分离官员激励效应与内在能力差异。核心发现表明：该制度实施后，地方党委书记退休剩余年限（纾困激励代理变量）每增加一年，市政企业债券利差下降约2.5个基点，发行规模增长约2.0%。上述效应在财政压力较大的城市显著增强。值得注意的是，在2017年问责制下，由纾困激励更强的党委书记领导的城市反而能够扩大市政企业债券发行规模，这与该制度抑制地方举债的初始意图相悖。

title: Political Accountability and Local Government Debt: Evidence from China
title_zh: 政治问责与地方政府债务：来自中国的证据

abstract: The use of pricing algorithms raises concerns about algorithmic collusion. This paper considers a sequential pricing model where marginal cost fluctuates over time. I find that Q-learning algorithms autonomously collude even under cost uncertainty. Collusion is sustained by strategies that involve reward-punishment schemes. It suggests that cost uncertainty is not an obstacle to autonomous algorithmic collusion.
abstract_zh: 定价算法的使用引发了对算法合谋的担忧。本文考虑了一个边际成本随时间波动的序贯定价模型。我发现，即使在成本不确定的情况下，Q学习算法也会自主合谋。合谋通过涉及奖励-惩罚机制的策略得以维持。这表明，成本不确定性并非自主算法合谋的障碍。
source_issue: International Journal of Industrial Organization, Volume 106
title: Algorithmic collusion under sequential pricing and stochastic costs
title_zh: 序贯定价与随机成本下的算法合谋

abstract: In a system of proportional representation, we study the interaction between a voters turnout decision and her party choice, and how these relate to party polarization. Quantal response equilibria predict such interaction effects. In particular they predict (i) a Polarization Effect: reduced strategic party choice when voting is voluntary makes voters more likely to vote for extreme parties (conditional on voting at all); (ii) an Extremist Effect: voters supporting extreme parties are most likely to vote; (iii) a Turnout Effect: party polarization increases voter turnout. We provide data from a laboratory experiment that support these theoretical predictions. In addition, we provide supporting empirical evidence from real world elections. Hence, the interaction between turnout and strategic voting that has been neglected in most of the previous literature is shown to be important.
abstract_zh: 在比例代表制体系中，我们研究了选民的投票参与决策与其政党选择之间的相互作用，以及这些因素如何与政党极化相关联。量子响应均衡预测了此类交互效应。具体而言，它们预测了（i）极化效应：当投票为自愿时，策略性政党选择减少，使得选民（在决定投票的前提下）更倾向于支持极端政党；（ii）极端主义效应：支持极端政党的选民最有可能参与投票；（iii）投票率效应：政党极化提高了选民投票率。我们提供了来自实验室实验的数据，这些数据支持上述理论预测。此外，我们还提供了来自现实世界选举的实证证据作为佐证。因此，先前多数文献中忽视的投票参与与策略性投票之间的相互作用被证明是重要的。
title: A simultaneous analysis of turnout and voting under proportional representation: Theory and experiments
title_zh: 比例代表制下投票率与投票行为的联合分析：理论与实验

abstract: Abstract Child protective services investigate a third of child-homes for maltreatment, yet repercussions for parents remain unclear. I show that mothers face considerable adversity when referred for alleged child maltreatment. Using a novel strategy that combines event studies with variation in intervention tendency across investigators, I find that child protective services interventions increase mothers’ enrollment in mental health and substance abuse treatment services for a year, even when those services are not mandated. Earnings and employment are unaffected. Marginal interventions can lead to persistent involvement with social services for years.
abstract_zh: 摘要 儿童保护服务对三分之一的儿童家庭进行了虐待调查，然而这对父母的影响仍不明确。我证明，当母亲因涉嫌儿童虐待而被转介时，她们面临相当大的困境。通过一种结合事件研究与调查员干预倾向差异的新策略，我发现儿童保护服务的干预措施增加了母亲在心理健康和物质滥用治疗服务中的注册率，持续一年，即使这些服务并非强制要求。收入与就业未受影响。边缘性干预可能导致与社会服务持续多年的牵连。
title: Effects of the Child Protection System on Parents
title_zh: 儿童保护制度对父母的影响

abstract: This study investigates the effects of male and female empowerment, as well as gender empowerment inequality, on the adoption of climate‐smart agriculture (CSA) practices. Using a conditional mixed process model, we analyse survey data from 743 households across Henan, Shandong and Hebei provinces in China. The results reveal that empowering both males and females significantly promotes the adoption of CSA practices. Male and female empowerment drives the adoption of CSA practices through improving income generation and reducing agricultural production costs. Higher levels of gender empowerment inequality are linked to reduced CSA practice adoption. The positive and negative impacts of male and female empowerment, as well as gender empowerment inequality, on the adoption of CSA practices among wheat growers cultivating medium‐scale farmland are the primary focus. Additionally, empowering women and narrowing gender inequality substantially boost wheat yields, whereas male empowerment shows no significant effect. These results highlight the importance of addressing gender disparities to promote sustainable agricultural practices and ensure food security. The study advocates policies that empower rural women, reduce gender inequality in access to empowerment and foster the widespread adoption of CSA technologies, thereby advancing gender equity and climate resilience in agricultural systems.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了男性和女性赋权以及性别赋权不平等对气候智能型农业（CSA）实践采纳的影响。通过使用条件混合过程模型，我们分析了来自中国河南、山东和河北三省743户家庭的调查数据。结果显示，同时赋权男性和女性显著促进了CSA实践的采纳。男性和女性赋权通过提高收入生成和降低农业生产成本，推动了CSA实践的采纳。性别赋权不平等程度越高，与CSA实践采纳的减少相关联。男性和女性赋权的正面与负面影响，以及性别赋权不平等对中等规模农田小麦种植者采纳CSA实践的影响，是本研究的主要关注点。此外，赋权女性并缩小性别不平等显著提高了小麦产量，而男性赋权则未显示出显著效果。这些结果强调了解决性别差异以促进可持续农业实践和确保粮食安全的重要性。本研究倡导制定政策，赋权农村女性，减少获取赋权方面的性别不平等，并促进CSA技术的广泛采纳，从而在农业系统中推进性别平等和气候韧性。
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
journal: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
title: Gender Empowerment and Climate‐Smart Agriculture: Insights and Implications for Achieving Gender Equity and Climate Resilience
title_zh: 性别赋权与气候智慧型农业：实现性别平等与气候韧性的洞见与启示

abstract: We use a historical episode of EU integration to analyse how the integration of Central and Eastern European countries (CEECs) in the EU has contributed to cross-border technology transfers. We modify the typical FDI spillover framework to analyse cross-border spillovers in regions close to the border. We then use a multi-country firm-level panel to analyse the impact of border regimes on the existence and size of cross-border spillovers, exploiting variation in the pace and extent of European integration of seven CEECs between 2000 and 2010. We find EU membership to be a necessary condition for cross-border productivity spillovers to emerge via backward linkages. Schengen area participation further magnifies these spillovers. Our results bear testimony to the successful EU integration of CEECs and warn about potential productivity costs of reinstating border restrictions.
title: European integration, border regimes, and cross-border technology diffusion through FDI spillovers
title_zh: 欧洲一体化、边境制度与通过FDI溢出效应的跨境技术扩散

abstract: Observation-driven models for time series have a long history in statistics and econometrics, but are typically studied under the assumption of correct dynamic specification. We develop an in-fill asymptotic framework to study the limiting behavior of the estimated (i.e., filtered) time-varying parameter paths obtained with such models in (severely) mis-specified settings. We show that despite such mis-specification, the filtered paths, particularly those from the class of score-driven models of Creal et al. (2011, 2013) and Harvey (2013), still converge in probability to the Kullback-Leibler optimal time-varying parameter paths, even in severely mis-specified settings. We obtain distributional convergence results for the filtering errors and formulate the observation-driven filter that minimizes the asymptotic filter error variance. Such an optimal filter again has score-driven features. The results substantially generalize earlier findings, which we demonstrate by applying the new theory to time-varying tail shape models, dynamic copulas, and time-varying regression models. We further highlight the practical relevance of the asymptotic results by using them to construct pointwise intervals that quantify the uncertainty of filtered parameter paths based on observation-driven filters and apply these to the volatility path of intraday Pfizer log-returns.
abstract_zh: 时间序列的观测驱动模型在统计学和计量经济学中有着悠久的历史，但通常是在正确动态设定的假设下进行研究。我们发展了一个填充渐近框架，以研究在（严重）误设定情形下，此类模型所估计（即滤波）的时变参数路径的极限行为。我们表明，尽管存在这种误设定，滤波路径——尤其是来自Creal等人（2011, 2013）和Harvey（2013）的得分驱动模型类——即使在严重误设定情形下，仍以概率收敛于Kullback-Leibler最优时变参数路径。我们获得了滤波误差的分布收敛结果，并构建了最小化渐近滤波误差方差的观测驱动滤波器。这种最优滤波器同样具有得分驱动的特征。这些结果大幅推广了早期发现，我们通过将新理论应用于时变尾部形状模型、动态copula和时变回归模型来加以证明。我们进一步通过利用这些渐近结果构建点态区间来突出其实践相关性，这些区间量化了基于观测驱动滤波器的滤波参数路径的不确定性，并将其应用于辉瑞公司日内对数收益的波动率路径。
title: Consistency, distributional convergence, and optimality of time-varying parameters in score-driven models
title_zh: 得分驱动模型中时变参数的一致性、分布收敛性与最优性

abstract: I construct the first annual-frequency dataset of agricultural output for China’s Yangzi Delta covering the period 1393–1953. Over six centuries, agriculture in the region expanded in total output but exhibited little per capita growth and no significant productivity improvement after the fifteenth century. Using the new data, I estimate representative rural household income and per capita GDP. The results indicate that by the late seventeenth century, both measures in the Yangzi Delta had fallen behind those of leading Western economies, including Britain, the Netherlands, and Italy. The timing of the Great Divergence thus lies between the estimates proposed by traditional Eurocentric scholars and those of the California School.
abstract_zh: 我构建了首个覆盖1393至1953年间中国长三角地区农业产出的年度频率数据集。在这六个世纪里，该地区农业总产出有所增长，但人均产出增长甚微，且自十五世纪后未见显著的生产率提升。利用这一新数据，我估算了代表性农村家庭收入及人均GDP。结果显示，至十七世纪末，长三角地区的这两项指标均已落后于包括英国、荷兰和意大利在内的西方主要经济体。因此，大分流的时点介于传统欧洲中心主义学者与加州学派提出的估计之间。
china_relevance_reason: 摘要仅出现一次中国相关表述，需确认中国是否为核心研究对象
title: Agricultural growth in the Yangzi Delta: 1393–1953
title_zh: 长江三角洲的农业增长：1393–1953

abstract: We present new annual time-series data on academic human capital across Europe from 1200 to 1793, constructed by aggregating individual-level measures at three geographic scales: cities, present-day countries (as of 2025), and historically informed macro-regions. Individual human capital is derived from a composite index of publication outcomes, based on data from the Repertorium Eruditorum Totius Europae (RETE) database. The macro-regional classifications are designed to reflect historically coherent entities, offering a more relevant perspective than modern national boundaries. This framework allows us to document key patterns, including the Little Divergence in academic human capital between Northern and Southern Europe, the effect of the Black Death and the Thirty Years’ War on academic human capital, the respective contributions of academies and universities, regional inequality across Catholic and Protestant areas of the Holy Roman Empire, and the distinctiveness of the Scottish Enlightenment.
abstract_zh: 我们提供了欧洲1200年至1793年间学术人力资本的新的年度时间序列数据，这些数据通过在城市、现代国家（截至2025年）和历史宏观区域三个地理尺度上汇总个体层面的测量值构建而成。个体人力资本来源于基于《欧洲学者名录》（RETE）数据库的出版成果综合指数。宏观区域分类旨在反映历史上连贯的实体，比现代国家边界提供了更相关的视角。这一框架使我们能够记录关键模式，包括北欧与南欧之间学术人力资本的“小分流”、黑死病和三十年战争对学术人力资本的影响、学院与大学各自的贡献、神圣罗马帝国内天主教与新教地区的区域不平等，以及苏格兰启蒙运动的独特性。
title: Academic human capital in European countries and regions, 1200–1793
title_zh: 欧洲国家与地区的学术人力资本（1200–1793）
